request.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Input is a reference only for finish quality; fully reimagine the screen. Design Buki as a modern soft-gel and paper children's creativity app. Exact text "Buki" appears in rounded translucent bubble letters with solid colored cores, readable and premium. Replace the old line and flower with a floating gel cord made from three connected bubbles, ending in an abstract bloom cluster of five glossy translucent circles, clearly not the original flower. Build a new portrait blank sketchpad with a pillowy rounded outer shell, cloud-cut page corners, a small set of capsule-shaped binding clips, subtle dot grid, inner safe frame, and colorful side bubbles used as tabs. Use aqua #42C7C6, berry #DF5C91, tangerine #FF8B48, lavender #9B83DC, sunshine #FFD45C, vanilla #FFF5E7. Camera control is a glassy aqua capsule anchored to a shallow bottom dock. Bright and childy but composed like a premium toy, minimal and implementable in Expo/Skia. Blank page, exact text "Buki" only. No device frame, no other copy, no giant character, no photorealistic environment.
